violations.why: closer2_isr writes 42 then checks it. closer1_isr has equal priority, so it can preempt in between and clear the variable in i8xx_tco_release. The check then fails.
closer1_isr writes tco_expect_close and later clears it. closer2_isr can preempt between the two and read the value in between.
closer2_isr reads test_global_var1 twice in JudgeCondi. closer1_isr can preempt between the reads and write it, because condition3 is 1.
writer1_isr writes array[9000] and later reads it. The higher-priority closer1_isr can preempt in between and overwrite it with 999.
